request.prompt: A straight thin concrete wall segment, as tall as it is long and ten times thinner than it is tall: exactly two flat precast reinforced-concrete panels standing edge to edge in one straight line, each panel 1.5 metres wide, 3 metres tall and only 0.3 metres thick, each standing on a flat foot slab 1.2 metres deep that sticks out equally in front and behind at ground level, so the end view is an upside-down letter T. A hairline joint between the two panels, chamfered top edge, two small steel lifting loops on top of each panel, weathered grey concrete, rust streaks under the loops, dust at the foot.
